title: Probability of a predicate on a word segment
statement: Let $s,T,m\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $s+T\le m$, and let $B$ be a predicate on Boolean words. The probability that the length-$T$ segment obtained by dropping the first $s$ bits of a uniformly random Boolean word of length $m$ satisfies $B$ equals the probability that a uniformly random Boolean word of length $T$ satisfies $B$.
